name: dramatic-chiaroscuro-brunette-fashion
image_purpose: fashion lookbook and magazine editorial portrait

prompt.project_info: Create an 8K photorealistic eye-level close-up fashion portrait of one original approved adult woman in dramatic chiaroscuro light.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with long voluminous dark-brunette hair, hazel-brown eyes, sharp winged eyeliner, natural dewy skin texture, high cheekbones, soft full lips, and a confident direct gaze. She wears a simple black short-sleeved top and a gold chain necklace while one hand runs through her hair at the crown.
composition_elements: Eye-level close-up with sharp focus on eyes and shallow depth of field.
Hand lifts hair at the crown with loose strands falling across the face.
Neutral gray background and diagonal division between light and deep shadow.
Keep face, hair, hand, necklace, and natural skin detail coherent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Hard directional sunlight beam across the face with deep chiaroscuro shadow covering half the face and body, warm skin against deep black and neutral gray, cinematic controlled contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 9:16 portrait, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field, 8K detail, sharp eyes, realistic fabric, hair, hand, and skin texture, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
